sights.n: Umeda Sky Building — Kuchū Teien Floating Garden Observatory
sights.address: Umeda Sky Building, northwest of JR Osaka Station, Kita-ku, Osaka, Japan
sights.w: The 173 m twin-tower skyscraper (1993) joined at the top by the open-air Floating Garden observation deck — 360° views over Osaka, open till 22:30.
Temma's shrine to Sugawara no Michizane, god of learning, at the head of Tenjinbashi-suji; home of the Tenjin Matsuri.
The national mint where Japan's coins are struck; famous for opening its riverside avenue of cherry trees to the public each spring.

sights.address: HEP Five, east of Hankyu Umeda, Kita-ku, Osaka, Japan
sights.w: A red Ferris wheel bursting from the roof of the HEP shopping complex in Umeda — 106 m high, with views over Kita.
